published_title: I Want That Ship or The Star Destroyer Shuffle
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''BronzeDynamo''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.
description: I can't take credit for the resurgence of this Idea (someone else inspired me to revise my ancient- SE vintage- Big Blue deck).  But it is fun and OWNS most WYS decks.

notes: Posted 7 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents, Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points, plus '(third effect Varies)'; these count toward the 60. The varying third effect is not named, so it has no row.
The deck totals 61 named cards as published (62 if the unnamed third starting effect is counted).

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the pre-Coruscant Dark system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Coruscant DB' dested the Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Endor', 'Corulag' and 'Sullust' dested the Dark systems Endor (Dark), Corulag (Dark) and Sullust (Dark).

Posted 'IAO' (dropped by the draft) dested Imperial Arrest Order; 'SSPFT' dested Something Special Planned For Them; 'YCHF' dested You Cannot Hide Forever; 'Cdr Merjerrik' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Admiral Chiraneu' dested Admiral Chiraneau; 'Chimeara' dested Chimaera; 'Death Squadron SD' dested the starship Death Squadron Star Destroyer; 'Evader/Monnok' dested Evader & Monnok; 'Twilek Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor.
'(ISB Agents)' after Arica is the author's label for the character group above it, not a card.
